text:
Jordan (AE): Hey team — Customer ACME Systems (EU) wants an on-prem POC in their datacenter. They requested the VPC/private package and asked to waive the platform fee for the 30-day POC. Need quick guidance on pricing and deal desk path.
Priya (Deal Desk): @Jordan thanks. Key Qs: 1) expected GPU footprint during POC? 2) are they asking for telemetry/telemetry retention modifications? 3) do they require dedicated PKI/KMS integration (HSM)?
Jordan (AE): 1) small: 2x A100-equivalent for the duration (estimated). 2) yes — they want logs retained in their SIEM, and to limit Redwood telemetry (only health metrics). 3) yes KMS/HSM integration (customer-managed) is required.
Mateo (Eng POC): KMS: we can support client-side envelope keys + bring-your-own-KMS for the control plane, but on-prem HSM + our current installer needs a minor change (1-2 dev days) to wire HSM connectors and cert rotation. Also need to scope telemetry opt-out flag for POC.
Lara (Legal): Legal note — if we waive platform fee for 30 days, we should have a short SOW addendum that limits liability and clarifies that platform fee resumes upon production. Also flag export controls and EU data processing addendum (DPA) updates. I can draft a one-page SOW.
Noah (Finance): Platform fee is normally €12k/month for private small footprint. Waiving it for 30 days is OK if customer commits to at least a 6-month paid pilot or signs a PO covering infra costs. If they only want a free eval with no commitment we need an internal approval.
Priya (Deal Desk): Proposed structure: 30-day platform-fee waiver contingent on a 6-month minimum committed spend (prepay or PO) at a 20% onboarding discount. Support tier: default enterprise support applies; offer a temporary POC support wrap (monitoring + 4-hr response) included. Would require Deal Desk sign-off.
Jordan (AE): Customer balks at 6-month commit but is open to a refundable deposit/escrow for infra if we push back. They prefer not to sign long commits for POC.
Priya (Deal Desk): Alternative: accept a refundable infra deposit equal to one month platform fee + 20% commitment discount if they convert to paid within 45 days post-POC. We'll need approval from Finance for refundable deposit workflow.
Noah (Finance): Refundable deposit is OK, we need ops to account for it as liability. Also need to confirm tax treatment for EU customer. I'll take to finance ops.
Lara (Legal): If using refundable deposit, SOW should include conversion terms and timeline, plus data destruction clause post-POC if they don't convert. I can draft and loop in Compliance for DPA tweak.
Mateo (Eng POC): On the tech side, estimate 2 business days to make KMS toggle and HSM connector changes, then a 1-day smoke test on their infra. We can spin up a staging image for them. If we include telemetry opt-out, we must confirm alert routing for critical incidents (we need to be able to contact them).
Jordan (AE): Sounds like path forward. Priya — can you confirm if Deal Desk needs Exec sign-off for the 20% discount + refundable deposit structure? If yes, I'll escalate.
Priya (Deal Desk): For 20% and refundable-deposit path, Deal Desk approval is within my band up to 15%. Anything above 15% or structural concession (e.g., refund policy exceptions) needs Sales Ops VP sign-off. I'll prepare a short approval packet for VP review.
DealDeskBot: Approval request logged: DD-2026-4537 — 20% onboarding discount + refundable deposit flow. Requires VP Sales Ops review.
Jordan (AE): Thanks — I'll start the SOW ask and get customer to agree to refundable deposit. Also will capture their PCI/IT checklist and send over security Qs.
Lara (Legal): Please attach the customer's security questionnaire and KMS/HSM spec. I'll prep the SOW template and conversion clause.
Noah (Finance): FYI we should mark forecast as contingent until deposit clears. Also, if they prepay infra, that changes revenue recognition. I'll coordinate with accounting.
Jordan (AE): Looping ACME procurement. @ACME_Buyer — we're proposing a 30-day waived platform fee with a refundable deposit (1 month) and 20% onboarding discount if you convert within 45 days. Will that work? :slightly_smiling_face:
Jordan (AE): Thanks everyone — next steps: 1) Priya prepares approval packet 2) Lara drafts SOW addendum 3) Mateo schedules 2-day engineering work window 4) Noah confirms finance handling. I'll update thread as we get approvals. :thumbsup:
